chain.title: Pebbles Before Pickaxes
chain.desc: Loose Rocks generate scattered on the ground and are the one block you may still take bare-handed; four of them press into a cobblestone.

chain.title: Chips Off the Old World
chain.desc: Striking flint against a hard block knaps it into Flint Shards, the only cutting edge available before metal.

chain.title: First Edge
chain.desc: A flint shard lashed to a stick makes the Flint Knife, which unlocks fibre, string and leather cutting.

chain.title: Harvest the Undergrowth
chain.desc: Cutting leaves, vines, saplings, flowers, wheat or sugar cane with a knife yields Plant Fiber.

chain.title: Twisted Priorities
chain.desc: Three plant fibres twist into Plant String, the mod's substitute for spider silk, and it smelts into vanilla string.

chain.title: Bite Into Bark
chain.desc: Shard, string and stick make the Flint Axe, a weak saw that finally turns logs into sticks and lets you fell trees.

chain.title: Permission to Mine
chain.desc: The Flint Pickaxe is the first tool allowed to break stone and ore, since bare hands now drop nothing.

chain.title: Friction Fiction
chain.desc: Stick, string and a flint shard make the Fire Starter, which lights kindling laid on logs and can build a campfire outright.

chain.title: Toothed Paddle
chain.desc: Flint shards set along a wooden blade give the Macuahuitl, the flint-tier sword.

chain.title: Potter's Apprentice
chain.desc: Five sticks arranged into the Clay Tool, the shaping implement for every piece of pottery.

chain.title: Throwing the Clay
chain.desc: Striking a placed clay block with the clay tool works it through a sequence toward a chosen shape.

chain.title: Brick by Brick
chain.desc: The clay tool cuts clay balls or blocks into unfired Clay Bricks, which fire into vanilla bricks.

chain.title: Green Ware
chain.desc: Worked clay shaped into a Small Vessel, still soft and useless until it meets fire.

chain.title: Pocket Pottery
chain.desc: Firing the small vessel in a furnace or campfire gives storage that holds four stacks inside one inventory slot.

chain.title: Leaky by Design
chain.desc: The Clay Bucket comes off the pottery block unfired and will not hold a drop until it is baked.

chain.title: Hold Water
chain.desc: Fired into a Ceramic Bucket, this carries water and lava long before you can afford three iron ingots.

chain.title: The Big Jar
chain.desc: The fired Large Vessel is a nine-slot storage block that keeps its contents when broken and picked up.

chain.title: Steel Yourself
chain.desc: An Iron Knife outlasts flint by a wide margin and speeds every cutting recipe in the mod.

chain.title: Cutting Corners
chain.desc: The Iron Saw takes eight sticks out of a log where the flint axe managed six.

chain.title: Three Tools, One Handle
chain.desc: The Mattock merges axe, shovel and hoe into a single tool that mines all three block sets.

chain.title: Gem of All Trades
chain.desc: The Diamond Mattock carries the combined tool through the mid game at diamond speed and durability.

chain.title: The Last Handle
chain.desc: Smithing the diamond mattock with a netherite ingot ends the tool ladder for good.

notes: FULL CHAIN JUSTIFIED. No Tree Punching rewrites the first hour of the game and the chain above is literally the ladder it imposes: nothing but gravel, sand, dirt, leaves and loose rocks drops bare-handed (data/notreepunching/tags/blocks/always_drops.json), so flint knapping is the true game-start and every later tool hangs off it. Ordering is taken from the recipe graph in the jar, not from vibes: flint_knife needs only shard+stick, plant_fiber needs a knife (#notreepunching:knives on all eight fibre recipes), plant_string needs three fibres, and flint_axe and flint_pickaxe both need string, so the fibre detour is genuinely mandatory before any flint tool beyond the knife. MODDB AGREEMENT: moddb has only 5 notreepunching entries and its order (flint_shard 0.00 -> flint_knife 0.19 -> plant_string 0.58 -> flint_axe 0.75 -> flint_pickaxe 1.00) matches the recipe graph exactly. No conflicts. moddb has zero coverage of the pottery line, the loose rocks or the metal tool tiers; those come from the recipe graph alone. MECHANICS NOT EXPRESSIBLE AS RECIPES (verified in class files, not guessed): flint_shard has no datapack recipe and comes from knapping (EventHandler.class references FLINT_KNAPPABLE, FLINT_SHARD, KNAPPING and Config.flintKnappingSuccessChance); loose rocks are worldgen (Config.enableLooseRocksWorldGen, tag loose_rock_placeable_on); clay_worked, clay_bucket, clay_small_vessel, clay_large_vessel and clay_flower_pot have no recipes and are produced by hitting a placed pottery block with the clay tool (PotteryBlock.class, Config.potteryBlockSequences, tag notreepunching:pottery). DELIBERATE EXCLUSIONS: the nine cobblestone _slab/_stairs/_wall variants (andesite/diorite/granite x3) are excluded per the measured desirability rule; they are real, verified ids but were quested essentially zero times across the corpus. Also left out of the chain: clay_flower_pot (fires into a vanilla flower pot, no new capability) and ceramic_water_bucket (the filled state of ceramic_bucket, not a separate craft). DROPS: none - all 51 model-stem-and-lang-key ids verified, every chain and wheel id is in that set.
